blocks.text: Demonstration document. Not for filing or payment.
Copied by the controller from the L&I rate notice for the account below, effective January 1, 2026. The notice is kept in the 2026 tax file.
Base rates by risk class, dollars per hour worked

rows: Wood Frame Building Construction and Alterations

blocks.text: Rates for this account after the experience factor of 0.8740, dollars per hour worked

The first table shows the base rates on the notice; each row adds to its base rate. The experience factor applies to accident fund, Stay at Work and medical aid; supplemental pension is not experience-rated. In the second table each part is rounded to four places so that the four parts add to the hourly rate the account pays. Hourly rate and employee share per hour are as printed on the notice for 2026; the employee share is half of Stay at Work, medical aid and supplemental pension, worked out before rounding.
